items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Will be limited Wednesday
items.text:

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Spotted at practice Wednesday
items.text:

items.title: Davante Adams: Undergoes hamstring surgery
items.text:
Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Washington: Limited to begin week
items.text:
Washington was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice due to a knee injury, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Myles Garrett: Won't return in Week 8
items.text:
Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that the Rams won't open Garrett's (knee) practice window this week, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.
